articles.title: NNPC Limited completes crossing of OB3 Gas Pipeline over River Niger
articles.summary: The OB3 Pipeline, with a capacity of 2 billion standard cubic feet per day, serves as a backbone gas infrastructure linking the Eastern gas network to the Western network and extending connectivity to the Northern corridor through the AKK Pipeline.
articles.hausa_translation: NNPC Limited ta gama wucewa na bututun iskar gas OB3 a kan Kogin Niger. Bututun OB3, mai ikon isar da mahimman cubic feet na gas a yau-yau, shine asali na isar gas da ke haɗa sadarwar gas ta Gabas zuwa Yamma kuma ya haɗa ƴan ƴancin Arewa ta hanyar bututun AKK.
critical_questions: What is the timeline for OB3 operational completion and when will gas actually flow through this crossing to benefit end consumers?
Which companies hold contracts for maintenance and operations of the OB3 crossing, and are there cost overruns or delays compared to original projections?
Why is there limited detail on the engineering challenges overcome and independent verification of safety standards for a river crossing of this magnitude?
How will this infrastructure directly impact domestic gas supply and pricing for Nigerian consumers versus prioritizing export revenues?

critical_questions: What specific legislative achievements from his eight years in the House qualify him beyond tenure, and why frame experience as inherently superior?
Who benefits from framing the Senate as 'not for novices'—does this exclude qualified candidates and entrench incumbent advantage?

critical_questions: What specific passage triggered the police invitation, and has the textbook publisher or Ministry of Education responded to the mother's concerns?
